package com.a;
final class PanControl {
  static final class Cfg {
    int maxStarts;
    double lowLimit = 2.5;
    long minOnMs;
    boolean enabled;
    double same = 1.0;

-- M/M-rt/src/com/a/BPan.java --
package com.a;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
@NiagaraType
@NiagaraProperty(name = "unrelated", type = "int", defaultValue = "9")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "maxStarts", type = "int", defaultValue = "6")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "lowLimit", type = "double", defaultValue = "3d")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "minOn", type = "BRelTime", defaultValue = "BRelTime.makeMinutes(1)")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "enabled", type = "boolean", defaultValue = "true")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "same", type = "double", defaultValue = "1")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "delay", type = "BRelTime", defaultValue = "BRelTime.makeSeconds(30)")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "unread", type = "double", defaultValue = "7")
public class BPan extends BComponent {
  void cycle(PanControl.Cfg cfg) {
    cfg.maxStarts = getMaxStarts();
    cfg.lowLimit  = getLowLimit();
    cfg.minOnMs   = getMinOn().getMillis();
    cfg.enabled   = getEnabled();
    cfg.same      = getSame();
    cfg.delaySec  = getDelay().getSeconds();
  }
}
